name: Carlsbad Caverns National Park
description: Beneath the Guadalupe Mountains of southeastern New Mexico lie more than 80 caves, packed with towering stalagmites, delicate stalactites and other mineral formations. The star is the Big Room, a limestone chamber nearly 4,000 feet long and 255 feet high at its tallest, the largest in North America. You can walk in through the natural entrance or take an elevator down. Pristine Lechuguilla Cave is kept for research.
